call_points.text: Vaccines continued double-digit performance, led by pediatric and adult vaccines like Shingrix.
Full-year EBITDA margins improved by 290 bps YoY to 34% driven by field force productivity and AI-led optimization.
Year-end cash position reached ₹2,745 crores with a return on capital employed of 61.0%.
The board recommended a final dividend of ₹57 per equity share.

guidance.statement: EBITDA margins to be roughly what we were at last year in 34% kind of range for FY27
Established general medicines and vaccines business to grow 8-10% as part of the ₹8,000 Cr top-line ambition over four to five years
Blenrep launch in India in the next two to three months, most probably Q2 or Q3 FY27
Bepirovirsen launch in India in the next three quarters latest

operating_notes.text: Shingrix grew 65% in Q1FY27 and sells upwards of 45,000-50,000 doses a quarter; it is an INR100 crores plus brand on a MAT basis.
Blended MR productivity is INR15-16 lakh per rep, up 5-6% this quarter; oncology has about 40-45 people and does INR10 crores a month.
About 44-45% of the GenMeds portfolio is under price control; Q1 volume growth was 3-3.5% and price about 6%.

timeline.summary: GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Limited’s Board recommended a final dividend of ₹57 per equity share (₹10 face value) for FY2026, pending AGM approval.
GSK India announced FY26 financial results with revenue of ₹3,790 Cr, PAT of ₹1,012 Cr, and a final dividend recommendation of ₹57 per share.
Ajay Avinash Nadkarni, Vice President – Administration, Real Estate & Company Secretary, uploaded analyst/institutional investor meet recording on May 13, 2026.
GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals reported Q4FY26 revenue of ₹995.3 Cr and PAT of ₹277.9 Cr, with full-year revenue up 2% to ₹3,821.67 Cr.

On its 3 August 2026 Q1FY27 call, GSK Pharma reported standalone sales of ₹924 Cr (+15% YoY) and PAT of ₹253 Cr (+24%, about 17% excluding a Biddle Sawyer dividend), and guided FY27 EBITDA margin to roughly 34%.

watchlist.response: Management deferred, citing the 40 million disease burden and saying it would answer specifics in the Q2 call after completing its roadmap work; evasive on treated-patient numbers.
watchlist.text: Analyst pressed on how many hepatitis B patients are actually treated in India and the commercial model for Bepirovirsen (cure vs lifelong therapy).

watchlist.response: CFO said the concentration was deliberate and front-loaded before the September quarter, and S&A ratios should normalise to historical trends through the year.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked whether the 36% YoY opex rise is a one-off or a run-rate.

watchlist.response: MD said it is not a current priority and GSK is not part of the global trials, then said he did not know which company ran the India trial; no timeline given.
watchlist.text: Analyst asked about the 24-valent pneumococcal vaccine trial in India and whether it is an FY29 launch.
